sections.title: The Concept: Explicit vs. Implicit
lecture_lines: Explicit functions isolate the variable y.
Implicit relations keep y trapped inside.
animations: Show explicit equation y=f(x) in #FFFFFF at center.
Show implicit equation F(x,y)=0 in #00FFFF below the explicit equation.
Highlight x and y variables in #FFD700 within both equations.

sections.title: The Key Prerequisite: The Chain Rule
lecture_lines: Differentiating y requires the Chain Rule.
Treat y as a function of x.
animations: Animate highlighting of g(x) and its derivative g'(x) in #FFFF00.
Show dynamic arrows connecting g(x) and g'(x) in #FF69B4.

sections.title: Step-by-Step Procedure
lecture_lines: Differentiate both sides with respect to x.
animations: Display equation F(x,y)=c; animate d/dx operator appearing on both sides.
Group dy/dx terms on left side; highlight in #00FF00.

sections.title: Application: The Robot Arm Path
lecture_lines: Implicit differentiation finds paths for robots.
animations: Draw point (x,y) on curve moving along path.
Draw tangent vector (dy/dx) in #FF4500 moving with point.

sections.title: Summary & Quick Check
lecture_lines: Always treat y as a function.
